text:
Priya: quick alert — Translate-Bridge (Bridge-XL) int4-mamba bringup shows locale-specific detok/tokenization glitches for CJK + RTL on the new quant path. Symptoms: stray spaces before Japanese full stop, ZWJ removed in zh emoji clusters, Arabic punctuation detached. Posting minimal repro + examples. @Kenji @Omar please triage.

Kenji: thanks. minimal repro?

Priya: ran a targeted roundtrip eval locally:
```bash
python infra/eval_roundtrip.py \
  --service=translate-bridge --model=bridge-xl \
  --quant_profile=int4-mamba --samples=150 \
  --locales=ja,zh,ar --detok=auto \
  --out=/tmp/bridge_int4_roundtrip.jsonl
```

Priya: sample diffs (detoked strings):
- float baseline (ja): "\u306b\u884c\u3063\u305f\u3002"
- int4 detok: "\u306b\u884c\u3063\u305f  \u3002"  <-- extra space before punctuation

- float baseline (zh): "\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u6b22"
- int4 detok: "\ud83d\ude0a  \u6b22"  <-- ZWJ removed, gap inserted

- float baseline (ar): "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645\u060c\u0623\u0647"
- int4 detok: "\u0627\u0644\u0633\u0644\u0627\u0645 \u060c \u0623\u0647"  <-- spaced comma

Omar: first hypothesis: tokenizer serialization mismatch between bridge runtime and quant image or detok normalization flag on the quant fastpath. did we change normalize_zwsp or merge_punct recently?

Priya: we rolled PR #4012 (normalize-zwsp) and PR #4035 (detok-merge-punct) last month. float canaries picked them up but int4 images were built before PR #4035 landed.

Kenji: i'm launching a small canary pinned to tokenizer v2026-03-15 and forcing `--detok=legacy` to see if behavior follows tokenizer or runtime config.

build-bot: Canary started: canary/5078901234-1 (bridge-xl int4-mamba)  40 samples ja/zh/ar. ETA ~14m.

Sofia: please include raw token id dumps for failing samples (byte-level) so we can see split boundaries vs detok normalization. if ids match between float/quant, it's runtime detok.

Priya: good point. i'll run a 30-sample debug with `--dump-ids` and `--detok=norm-punct` and push to /tmp/bridge_int4_ids.jsonl.

Omar: if this is runtime config drift, quick mitigation is routing policy: route ja/zh/ar traffic to float for 90% and keep 10% on quant for telemetry. we can flip via rollout rules.

Kenji: logging excerpt from the pinned canary (partial):
```
INFO tokenizer=v2026-03-15 loaded
INFO model-checkpoint: bridge-xl-int4-2026-03-21
DEBUG sample[11] locale=ja input="\u3053\u308c\u306f\u6771\u4eac\u3002" detok_out="\u3053\u308c\u306f\u6771\u4eac  \u3002"
DEBUG sample[22] locale=zh input="\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u6b22" detok_out="\ud83d\ude0a\u200d\u6b22"
```

Kenji: interesting — with tokenizer pinned, ZWJ preserved in many zh samples but ja spacing still present. points to detok normalization differences in quant runtime.

Sofia: can you dump the detok-norm flags for quant-fastpath? i.e., is merge_punct true/false and norm_zwsp enabled? instrument the server to log `DETOK-FLAGS` in debug mode.

Omar: i'll check the image bake logs to verify which runtime-config blob was embedded. previous quant bake on 2026-03-09 used runtime-config v1.12 which predates detok-merge-punct.

Priya: metrics from the initial 150-sample run: ja->en BLEU -1.7, zh->en -0.8, ar->en -3.5 (subset with punctuation-heavy). COMET shows more degradation on ar set. chrF changes minor.

Kenji: running a control against older int4 build (int4-mamba-2026-03-08) to confirm delta.

Sofia: added a short detok golden test to CI proposal: assert ZWJ presence for a few emoji-glue zh cases and assert no trailing space before CJK punctuation. can someone open the ticket?

Priya: i'll open TICKET-ML-721 and add failing samples + token id dumps. attaching logs when done.

Omar: plan of action: 1) verify runtime-config blob in quant images and rebuild with synced detok flags (Omar) 2) pin tokenizer serialization in quant CI (Kenji) 3) run instrumented canary with DETOK-FLAGS logging (Kenji + Sofia) 4) consider short routing fallback if user metrics cross threshold (SRE/Product).

Kenji: timeline: i can get a canary instrumented run within 3h after the rebuild.

Priya: thanks — will post results. ping @infra if we need a hotfix image. :thumbsup:
